scope: All seven current parser functions have executable selected specializations and are called directly in a fresh canonical VM batch. header and header_global agree with Stage-0 project checks where the bounded global fuel policy permits completion, Cranelift, and canonical VM across frontend header fixtures, long dotted module names, all tested page strides, non-ASCII input, and the fuel boundary. Direct header_with_locations_global maps the two byte offsets of each parser diagnostic through Source.line_col_span_global and agrees with a byte-based location oracle across reference interpreter, Cranelift, and canonical VM, including a zero-stride page. Direct finish/step helper calls use typed Header states and agree across the reference interpreter, Cranelift, and canonical VM. This covers every parser function at the listed specializations and selected states; it does not prove all type arguments, full compiler succession, Stage-1, or Stage-2.
